{{Quote|The Zabrak with the sunny disposition is my chief engineer, Arim.|Revald|<ref name="AR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Arms Race|Hoth}}</ref>}}
'''Arim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served as a [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Zerek]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], working with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Revald]] on retrieving the [[Null Cannon]] from the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]]. Arim led a backup team that interrupted Republic negotiations with [[Sero]], making him believe he was betrayed and attack. After being forced to kill him, Arim and Republic citizen contemplated on dealing with multiple copies of the Null Cannon.<ref name="AR" /><ref name="NC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Null Cannon|Hoth}}</ref>
